summary.zh-CN: 推出可发现、安装和管理的 Mini App 体系，并首发包含待办、Markdown 笔记、收藏和日历的个人空间。
summary.en-US: Introduces discoverable, installable Mini Apps and the first Personal Space bundle with Todos, Markdown Notes, Favorites, and Calendar.

title.zh-CN: Mini App 市场与生命周期

body.zh-CN: 在 Apps 中发现、安装、启用、打开、更新、回滚和卸载组合应用。
body.en-US: Discover, install, enable, open, update, roll back, and uninstall composite apps from Apps.

body.zh-CN: 待办、Markdown 笔记、收藏和日历拥有独立入口，并共享稳定的本地数据服务。
body.en-US: Todos, Markdown Notes, Favorites, and Calendar have dedicated entries backed by one stable local data service.

body.zh-CN: 收件箱报告、定时任务、文件和文件夹可以通过 @ 面板搜索并带入会话。
body.en-US: Inbox reports, scheduled tasks, files, and folders can be searched and added through the @ panel.

title.zh-CN: 更完整的 Apps 体验

body.zh-CN: 增加市场发现、已安装状态、权限确认、包级管理和窄面板适配。
body.en-US: Adds marketplace discovery, installed state, permission confirmation, package-level controls, and narrow-panel support.

body.zh-CN: 会话视图切换更紧凑，文件 Explorer 记住可见状态并同步外部选择。
body.en-US: Session view switching is more compact, and the file Explorer remembers visibility while tracking external selections.

body.zh-CN: 稳定 launcher 会拉起刚安装的版本，使页面、内核和真实进程版本保持一致。
body.en-US: The stable launcher starts the newly installed version so the UI, kernel, and actual process stay aligned.

body.zh-CN: 应用事务、完整性校验、下载预算、授权清理和日历订阅网络限制共同避免残留与越界。
body.en-US: Atomic transactions, integrity checks, download budgets, grant cleanup, and calendar network restrictions prevent partial or unsafe state.

title.zh-CN: 代码版本与个人数据分离

body.zh-CN: 应用代码按版本不可变保存，个人数据跨升级、回滚和重装保持稳定。
body.en-US: App code is immutable per version while personal data remains stable across upgrades, rollbacks, and reinstalls.

body.zh-CN: 既有 Panel、Service 和 .napp v1 路径保持可用，组合包使用 schema v2。
body.en-US: Existing Panel, Service, and .napp v1 paths remain available, while composite packages use schema v2.
